units.source_text: “非常感谢您对我们忠义的认可。

en.t: Thank you very much for recognizing our loyalty.

units.source_text: 但是，我个人的想法是首先觉得羞耻。”

en.t: But personally, my first feeling is shame.

units.source_text: 他说着，四下看了下在座的人们。

en.t: As he said this, he looked around at the people seated there.

units.source_text: “这是因为，虽然赤穗藩的人口很多，但是正如你看见的那样，

en.t: The reason is that although the Ako domain has many people, as you can see,

units.source_text: 这里主要是身份卑下的人。

en.t: those gathered here are mainly men of low rank.

units.source_text: 当然，一开始奥野将监警卫长参与了计划的磋商，

en.t: Of course, at first Okuno Shogen, the captain of the guard, took part in discussions of the plan,

units.source_text: 但是他中途改变了注意，最后脱离了同盟，真是非常让人遗憾的。

en.t: but he changed his mind midway and finally left the alliance, which is truly regrettable.

units.source_text: 除此以外，进藤源四郎、河村传兵卫、小山源五左卫门等人都比原总右卫门的地位高，

en.t: Besides them, Shindo Genshiro, Kawamura Denbei, Koyama Gengozaemon, and others all held higher positions than Hara Soemon,

units.source_text: 佐佐小左卫门等人也比吉田忠左卫门的身份高，

en.t: and Sasa Kozaemon and the others were also of higher rank than Yoshida Chuzaemon,

units.source_text: 但是他们就要发动起义的时候，他们都变了心。

en.t: but when the moment came to launch the uprising, they all changed their minds.

units.source_text: 而且这里面还有我的亲属。

en.t: Moreover, among them were even relatives of mine.

units.source_text: 正是因为如此，我才会感觉到无比羞耻。”

en.t: That is precisely why I feel such unbearable shame.
